vintage: INSEE census 2023 and comparateur de territoires, geography 2026; historical population and housing series

methodology.spatial_distribution: 1 km lattice over current commune polygons; uniform within each commune

lenses.name: Population history
lenses.description: Residents per km² in nine census snapshots from 1968 to 2023. Zero values clamp to the bottom of the log colour scale. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.
